nora_partnerships: Heads-up 1: PartnerAtlas wants a coordinated marketplace tile + co-blog + a follow-up webinar. Can we map owners here quick?

max_marketing: Timeline request: soft launch May 9, public push May 13. We need hero copy, 2 screenshots, datasheet, and a partner quote by May 6.

tara_csm: CSM needs a sandbox tenant + onboarding checklist. Prefer a step-by-step quickstart + 3 troubleshooting FAQs.

eli_engineering: We'll produce a marketplace package (OCI image) and a terraform example. Need to know target region and whether demo uses cached checkpoint.

hao_legal: I'll validate the joint statement and partner logo use. Also check for any export-control flags for the partner's country.

simon_sales: Sales asks: include pricing metadata and a partner promo code; also want a short one-pager for deals desk.

publishbot: scheduled: partneratlas-staging-publish -> 2026-05-09T09:00:00Z. Requires: release tag partneratlas-ga.

max_marketing: Proposed rehearsal: May 7 dry-run for publish steps (20m) + May 8 content QA (30m). Who can make it?

nora_partnerships: I'll coordinate partner approvals and upload the datasheet. Partner already sent an authoritative quote we can use.

eli_engineering: Quick infra snippet for ops (will share vars): region=us-west-2, instance=r5.xlarge, demo_users=3.

tara_csm: I'll draft the onboarding checklist and include SSO steps + escalation path. Will post a link when ready.

hao_legal: Action: I'll request partner signoff by May 5 and confirm embargo timing. No outreach until we have the signed copy.

max_marketing: Action owners: @hao_legal legal signoff, @eli_engineering package + demo creds, @tara_csm onboarding doc, @simon_sales pricing + one-pager, @nora_partnerships partner approvals.

nora_partnerships: Thanks everyone 1 I'll send a small spreadsheet with due dates after this thread. :thumbsup:
